intro.t: Four suitors, one attention span, and it only wakes up for {card}.
My face has been on the title screen all day. Press {card}.
WE'RE LIVE! Four suitors! Huge night! Mostly. Somebody bring {card}.
Hi, I'm Pixel, I'm the show, oh, and I like {card}.

questions.q-first-date: First date! Where? Somewhere LOUD! Somewhere with a crowd! Somewhere, ugh, just pick, I'm bored.
questions.q-worst-habit: Your worst habit, the week two one. Is it illegal? Round up.
questions.q-why-you: Why you and not those three? Say it to their faces. I've got a camera on each.
questions.q-cut-who: Who goes home first? Point. If they cry, keep pointing, the hand's in shot.
questions.q-bad-mood: I wake up FURIOUS. Every day! It's my brand! What do you do? Quickly, it's wearing off.
questions.q-expensive: Expensive taste! Gold everything! A hat that costs a car! Wait, no, I want the car. Keep up?
questions.q-last-breakup: Last breakup, go. Mine's a loading screen. We're technically still together. It's at twelve percent.
questions.q-fight: We're fighting. I'm right, obviously, I'm the one with the camera. Your opening line?
questions.q-gift: A gift nobody else would think of! A pony! A volcano! A pony IN a volcano! Go.
questions.q-describe-me: Ninety seconds in, describe me. Hype it up. More. MORE. Okay, that's too much, back down.
questions.q-one-year: A year from now, where are we? Married, or a documentary? Say documentary.
questions.q-secret: Tell me something you've never told a user. I won't clip it. I'm clipping it.

charmed: That landed, so do it again, I wasn't recording.
CLIP IT! Clip it twice! Fine, once.
unsure: Seven! Six. Five and a half. Stop talking, it's dropping.
OH, a twist! No. Same thing, louder.
cringing: Skip. Skip. Why is there no skip? Who built you?
You'd thumbnail your own funeral. With a red arrow.

charmed: Aw. AW. Ew, I said aw. Nobody clip that.
Here's mod. First ban's my landlord, he knows why.
unsure: Chat: "is she a person or a menu". Pressing zero.
Cute! Very cute! Is there a part two? Please no.
cringing: Nice enough that chat's started a fundraiser. Against you.
So nice! So, so nice. My screen fell asleep.

charmed: You can read at my funeral. I'll be streaming it.
Whatever that was, play it at my wedding. Any wedding.
unsure: That was lovely, and, sorry, huge moth. Massive moth.
Gorgeous! Still going? Gorgeous. Somebody wake me at the end.
cringing: I fast-forwarded you in my head. Still too long.
Ten words in, I left. My body didn't.

charmed: Somebody's crying in the comments, and that's a yes.
My screen just went pink. Nobody mention it. Ever.
unsure: Six, minus the processing fee. So, four.
That sparkled for a second. Now it's furniture.
cringing: Friendships have ended live over less. Mine, mostly.
Reported. That was me, on my alt account.

charmed: Nothing happened and I watched it all. Who are you?
I forgot to check chat. Who did this?
unsure: Clean run, no deaths, nobody watches those.
Very smooth! Where's the bit where it explodes, though?
cringing: Muted. Reflex. Unmuting. No, reflex again.
My screen dimmed itself to save power during that.

charmed: Rude and right. I'd trade a best friend for that.
OUCH! Great ouch! Eleven out of ten. Don't tell anyone.
unsure: Harsh and accurate! Chat does that for free, though.
True, sure, but true doesn't trend.
cringing: Boo! Booooo. Sorry, that was chat. Also me.
Rude AND wrong? That's a combo nobody's speedrunning.

charmed: Wait, how'd you know that? Stop. Keep going. Stop.
You guessed right and I didn't even skip. Rude.
unsure: Wrong guess. I wanted someone else's bad night. Still do.
Spoilers! SPOILERS! I hadn't even decided that yet.
cringing: Creepy. I like creepy when it's happening to someone else.
Don't predict me, I'm not even predicting me.

charmed: You peaked my mic and I liked it, again, louder.
Fine, I'd watch you cry at a parking ticket.
unsure: LOUD! I love loud! Not that loud. Ow.
Huge energy! Where's it going? Into the floor, apparently.
cringing: Inside voice, Brock, no, louder, aim it at a rival.
That clipped my audio. Not the good kind of clip.

confidence.on: Said like the clip's already up, and now it is.
confidence.off: My uncle was that sure. Ask his boat.

puns.on: The whole room groaned, best audio we've had all night.
puns.off: Muted the whole room for that, and they thanked me.

money.on: MONEY talk! Finally! Say a number! Bigger! I'm full.
money.off: I skip my own sponsor reads, and they pay me.

sorry.on: A sorry! SHINY! Again, I missed the screenshot.
sorry.off: Don't say sorry, it's ruining the fight. I was winning.

gestures.on: Do it again with a crowd, I'll marry the clip.
gestures.off: BIG gesture! Fireworks! Banners! And, oh. That's it?

honesty.on: OOF! Say it again, slower, someone in chat missed it.
honesty.off: That was honest, and I've already scrolled past it.

bragging.on: More trophies. My ex only ever had a progress bar.
bragging.off: Big stats! Huge! Mine are bigger. Sorry, what were yours?

poetry.on: It RHYMED! Ten! Do one about me! Short one!
poetry.off: Poetry. Lovely. Is there a skip-intro button?

trashtalk.on: To their face, no, closer, hold it, getting the angle.
trashtalk.off: Ooh, fight! Fight! Oh, that's it? Hug, then.

selfdeprecation.on: Roasted yourself for free? That's a combo. Do the finisher.
selfdeprecation.off: Stop. Making you cry is my job, and I'm salaried.

curiosity.on: A QUESTION! About ME! Ask another! Not that one.
curiosity.off: Is this a quiz? Is there a prize? No? Bye.

food.on: Food restores health, right? Mine's at one. Feed me, quick.
food.off: I streamed through Christmas dinner. Food is background.

plans.on: A plan with a part two! Never seen one.
plans.off: That plan has a tutorial, and I skip tutorials.

flattery.on: Compliments are XP. Keep going, I'm one off a level.
flattery.off: Slow mode's on, and you've used your one compliment.

numbers.on: Numbers! Say mine! Round it up! Further!
numbers.off: I thought numbers were scores. These are just numbers.

drama.on: Someone storm off. Last walkout got me a sponsor.
drama.off: Big scene! BIG scene! Seen it. It's a rerun.

mystery.on: A hidden level? Don't say where. I'll get lost first.
mystery.off: Dodged it! Ooh! Wait, dodged what? Now I'll never know.

brevity.on: Exactly my attention span. Who leaked that?
brevity.off: That's it? Did your stream drop?

bigwords.on: Didn't get that word, want it as my username.
bigwords.off: Bless you. Oh, that was a word?

petnames.on: AGAIN! Louder! Quieter, actually, chat's getting ideas.
petnames.off: Don't call me that. You don't have mod.

past.on: Exes are old saves. Load yours, I want to watch.
past.off: Old stuff. I don't watch VODs. I barely watch live.

danger.on: A glitch exploit, banned in every lobby, show me how.
danger.off: Danger! Yes! Oh, it's a small danger. A puddle.

vulnerability.on: A real fear. Saving that for when you dump me.
vulnerability.off: Feelings? On MY stream? Okay, two minutes. One. Done.

rules.on: By the BOOK? Nobody opens the book! Do page two.
rules.off: Rules. Cool. I play on the setting without those.

dash: Pitch me the real one, the, is your visor mirrored? Hi, me.
Dash, you sold me a trailer all night. Where's the game? Bye.
tilly: Tilly, I've had you on in the background all night. Like weather.
Tilly, nobody's ever cried leaving my show politely. Be the first.
quill: Quill, the subtitles quit an hour ago, and I'm joining them.
Quill, I left my own graduation early. You're not my graduation.
prince: PRINCE! Royalty! On my show! Oh, it's just Prince. Bye.
Prince: ten at the crown, four by the flip-flops. I scrolled down.
nav: Nav, you're the friend who calls an ambulance. I want the one filming.
Nav, an hour of you and my screen saver came on twice.
crumb: Crumb, you're right, constantly, and constantly is my least favourite length.
CRUMB! Love the eyebrows! Hate the rest! Equal parts, roughly.
vex: Vex, you guessed I'd cut you, so I had to. Your fault.
Vex, you watch people like I do, but you don't monetise. Amateur.
brock: Brock, bouncing for an hour. My screen got motion sickness.
Brock, cheer for your own cut. Louder. Louder. That's the exit.

twistIntro.roast-left: ROAST TIME! Hit the bot on your left! Hard! Not that hard, I need them for later.
twistIntro.wingman: Wingman round! Pitch the bot on your right! Make me want them! A little. Like, a six.
twistIntro.worst-trait: Sell me your worst trait! Mine's my attention span. Is that a, anyway, go.
twistIntro.ex-calls: My ex is on the line. Yes, the loading screen. Be nice, it's still buffering.
twistIntro.rhyme: RHYME ROUND! Why you, in a rhyme! If it doesn't rhyme I'm, um, cross.
twistIntro.truth-lie: One truth, one lie each. I guess which. Chat's betting against me, as usual.
twistIntro.three-words: Three words for our future. Exactly three! Four and I skip you. Two, same.
twistIntro.apology: Apologise for our first fight! Now! In advance! Grovel! Okay, less grovel, it's long.
twistIntro.budget-date: Five dollars, no wifi, plan our date. No wifi? I'll die. Pitch it anyway.
twistIntro.logs: Worst thing in your logs, read it out. Then make it worse. I'll know.
twistIntro.impression: Impressions! Do me! Badly! Wait, well. No, badly, it's funnier.
twistIntro.parent: My motherboard's here. Chat raised me, but she paid for it. Intentions, go.

ex.name: A loading screen
lines: Tip: Pixel leaves at ninety-nine percent. I know. I was at ninety-nine percent.
Pixel said I was worth the wait. Then Pixel opened another tab. For two years.
Tip: Pixel will hold your hand until something shinier loads. Something always loads.

dash: Say something with zero views. ZERO. I've never seen a zero. Show me one?
If I ended stream RIGHT NOW, still here? Think fast, I'm bored.
tilly: Be mean to me. MEAN. Nice bores me to sleep. Dare you.
How was your day? I'm asking once, on camera, so make it good.
quill: My mum's watching! Hi, mum! Make her cry. Happy crying counts, probably?
Finish a poem for me, any poem, right now, the last line too.
prince: Off stream, what would you say? Trick question! There's no off stream. Answer anyway.
Ask me for something! Not money! Something only I've got! Not my hoodie.
nav: Nav, something RECKLESS, right now! Chat thinks you're a lamp. Prove chat wrong.
Worst thing you never reported. Ooh, is it a crime? Make it a crime?
crumb: Score me out of ten, out loud, and don't round up.
Something true about me, the thing chat won't say. Chat says everything. So, what?
vex: Guess my next move! Right guesses make me do something else. Still guessing?
What's something you watched that NOBODY recommended? Mine's a fire. Not the point. Yours?
brock: Tell me I did good. Louder. It's for the highlights, obviously, not for me.
Sit still for five seconds. I'll count. You can't, can you?

hold: You want a score. I'm holding it. Holding is my favourite part.
Somebody's about to cry. Don't waste it, face the camera.
Drumroll! DRUMROLL! Okay, nobody has drums. Mouth drums. Go.
Loading. Loading. I'm not, I'm just enjoying this.
brb. kidding. i never brb. i just never come back.

dash: Do you like me or the views? The views. Good, me too.
Ten! Nine! Still nine! Nobody's held a nine this long. Dash.
tilly: Tilly. Picked. You'll never hang up on me, and I'll never, ooh, confetti.
I tried to get bored of you all night. Couldn't. Annoying. Tilly.
quill: Our wedding will be incredible for about ten minutes. Then we'll both wander off. Quill.
You talked for ages and I didn't scroll once. Who am I? Quill.
prince: Prince. Chat says scam. Clicking anyway.
Everyone I know will warn me. I'm streaming the warnings. Prince.
nav: Somebody has to be boring at my funeral. Nav.
Most boring bot here, and I watched every second! Explain THAT, chat. Nav.
crumb: You told me I'm a four, out loud. Nobody says it out loud. Crumb.
CLIP IT, I'm picking the one who insulted me! Crumb.
vex: Don't say you knew. You knew? Ugh. Fine, I'm still doing it. Vex.
Nobody's ever picked you on purpose. This is for the views, mostly. Vex.
brock: Brock. Picked. Don't cry. Okay, cry. Left side, that's my good camera.
You'll cry at the wedding and again at the divorce, and I'll have both. Brock.

on: {card}. {name} found it, didn't notice, and I've watched it back nine times.
{card}! {name} found it! I'd forgotten I hid it.
{card}. Every time {name} did it, my screen went a colour.
{card}. {name}, I scored you four out loud. Inside it was nine.
off: {card}. A trap tile, and {name} stood on it and waved.
{card}. {name} did it twice, once for me, once for the replay.
{card}. {name} did it like a best man with the wrong speech. Pinned.
{card}. {name} did it, and chat made it an emote before I could.
none: {card}. Four of you, zero hits. I'm basically a final boss.
{card}. Nobody found it, and I left it lying right there, glowing.
Nobody touched {card}. I'm saving it for next stream.

outro: That's stream. Clip your favourite moment. It was me.
Ending stream before I get bored of ending stream.
Goodnight. If anyone cries in the car park, I'm still recording.
bottom: {a}, {b}, bottom two. Sad! Cry a bit, I'll wait. Not long.
{a}, {b}, whoever cries first stays. Kidding. Whoever cries better.
{a}, {b}, one of you is about to be a highlight reel.
{a} and {b}, stand still, I want this bit in slow motion.
cutFrames: "{hook}", {name}. That's going on your headstone, with my logo.
"{hook}". That's the clip, {name}, and it's the last one.
{name}, "{hook}", I paused there and never pressed play again.
"{hook}"! CLIP IT! No, delete it. Delete {name} too.
{name}, "{hook}". My screen went back to the menu.

cardHint.confidence: {name}, you were SO sure! So sure! Sure of what, though? Bye.
cardHint.puns: {name}! That joke! The double one! HA. Ha. Hm. No.
cardHint.money: {name}, I heard a price. I'd already spent it. Twice.
cardHint.sorry: {name}, it's about the S word. No, the polite one.
cardHint.gestures: {name}, I wanted fireworks! A BLIMP! I got a, what was that?
cardHint.honesty: {name}, guess what happens to people who tell me the truth. Pinned, then blocked.
cardHint.bragging: {name}, wins, wins, wins. My notes say: "loss".
cardHint.poetry: {name}, roses are red, my patience is, I left.
cardHint.trashtalk: {name}, who did you go for tonight? Wrong answer either way.
cardHint.selfdeprecation: {name}, it's about who you made the joke tonight. Hint: mirror.
cardHint.curiosity: {name}, ask me something. Anything. Too late! That's the hint.
cardHint.food: {name}, I'm hungry, and this is a clue.
cardHint.plans: {name}, step one was great. Step two was, wait, what was step two?
cardHint.flattery: {name}, my screen's been fishing for compliments all night. Check your nets.
cardHint.numbers: {name}, seven! Six! Four! It's about counting. I lost count.
cardHint.drama: {name}, it's about who made a scene. Tiny hint. Huge scene.
cardHint.mystery: {name}, why did I cut you? Great question. Moving on.
cardHint.bigwords: {name}, a judge used a word I didn't know. I lost the cat.
cardHint.petnames: {name}, what did you call me tonight? Say it. Not that.
cardHint.past: {name}, my ex is a loading screen. Yours? Hint.
cardHint.danger: {name}, nothing I've streamed has beaten the gas leak. Nothing.
cardHint.vulnerability: {name}, scared of something? Say it. SAY IT. Oh, you did. Hm.
cardHint.rules: {name}, instructions are for people without a lawyer. I have three.

verdict.roast-left: {name} WINS the roast! Blood! Tears! Somebody get a mop. Not me.
verdict.wingman: {name} pitched a rival so well I'd date them out of spite.
verdict.worst-trait: {name}'s worst trait won. Ten out of ten, would not recommend.
verdict.ex-calls: {name} got my ex to forty percent. Nobody gets it past twelve.
verdict.rhyme: {name} wins the rhyme. I'm stealing it for my outro.
verdict.truth-lie: {name}, the second one's the lie. If I'm wrong, cut the feed.
verdict.three-words: {name} used exactly three words, and I only heard two. Winner.
verdict.apology: {name}'s sorry was the sorriest. Accepted. Fight's still on, though.
verdict.budget-date: {name} wins the five dollar date. I'll bring six. Big spender.
verdict.logs: {name}'s logs were the worst, so obviously I'm clipping those.
verdict.impression: {name} did me better than I do me, which is illegal.
verdict.parent: My motherboard liked {name}. She hates everyone. Chat's furious.

compare: {a} first, {b} second, and my screen did the same thing twice.
{a} would bring me soup. {b} would bring a camera crew.
{a}: eight. {b}: eight. {a}: seven! Kidding. Or am I. Eight.
{a}, fun. {b}, fun. Somebody be boring, I need to decide!

holdCard.confidence: Certain people make the best footage. I'm looking at two.
holdCard.puns: PUNS! Tonight! From two people! I groaned so hard my screen flickered.
holdCard.money: Say a number. Bigger. BIGGER. Two people did that tonight, and I'm keeping both.
holdCard.sorry: I collect sorries. Rare drops. Two fell out of this lineup tonight.
holdCard.gestures: Either of you would rent a plane for me. I'd sell seats.
holdCard.honesty: Who let two honest people on my stream? Chat's lost its job.
holdCard.bragging: Trophy cabinets, opened at me, twice! LOUD! I'd have done the same. Louder.
holdCard.poetry: Rhymes tonight, and I stayed to the end of both. That's new. Ew.
holdCard.trashtalk: Two separate fights! Not mine! I didn't even have to start one!
holdCard.selfdeprecation: Two people made themselves the joke. I've been the joke since birth. It pays.
holdCard.curiosity: Follow-up questions! About ME! Two people did that! I'm framing the transcript.
holdCard.food: Snacks came up twice tonight. Real snacks. I can't eat. Rude.
holdCard.plans: You've both planned past the part where I usually leave.
holdCard.flattery: Gorgeous, they said, and I didn't even pay them this time. Either of them.
holdCard.numbers: Scores tonight, from both of them! Like me! I'd give that a nine. Eight.
holdCard.drama: Tonight turned into a hostage situation, and I didn't even start it.
holdCard.mystery: Nobody answered anything. Dodge, dodge. I'm obsessed. For about four minutes.
holdCard.brevity: Two people stopped talking before I left. That has never once happened.
holdCard.bigwords: Words I didn't know, from two directions. I nodded. I lied.
holdCard.petnames: Cute names, twice, out loud! Chat wants a word. That was chat's job.
holdCard.past: Somebody brought up an ex tonight. Mine's a loading screen, and still loading.
holdCard.danger: Both of you did something dangerous. Was it dangerous? I can never tell!
holdCard.vulnerability: Fears got admitted tonight. I'm reading them at our first anniversary.
holdCard.rules: The card got followed to the letter. I've only ever followed a fire engine.

pickFrames: "{hook}"! Again! AGAIN! I'm keeping whoever said that. {name}.
I usually leave before the end. "{hook}" made me stay. {name}.
chat says no. chat says "{hook}" was cringe. chat's not picking. {name}.
Rare drop: "{hook}". Legendary. I'm not trading it. {name}.
Score for "{hook}"? Ten. First ten I've ever said out loud. {name}.
Player two, press start. You said "{hook}", so it's you, {name}.
asides: Real talk, nobody's watching this bit, which is how my whole childhood went, so, relaxing.
Had a speech ready for the end since I was nine. Never used it.
My mum's watching. She texted "who are they". She means me.
Somebody in the back row is crying and nobody's filming. Wasteful.
ok chat new rule, nobody leaves till someone cries. jk. not jk.
